system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally you can see to pass into the realm of the Sidhe. The target steps into a nearby reflective surface and vanishes from view.

Activate a Countdown (4). Each time they make a roll with Fear while in the Mirror, tick down the Countdown. When it ticks 0, they are forced to re-emerge. When they re-emerge, they must mark Stress equal to the number of ticks marked on the Countdown. The target may exit through any reflective surface they can see.
